title: Proof run
description: One run of every test suite at one commit, with its attestation.

title: Test outcome
description: What one test record's test did in the run.

title: Gate verdict
description: The result of judging one commit at one gate, with every reason for a refusal.

title: Module requirements
description: The service's go.mod and go.sum, as resolution left them.

title: Module cache
description: One cache: the source revision it serves, the Go SDK that downloaded it, and its inventory.

title: Cached module
description: One module zip in the cache.

title: Application build
description: The build and its record: what went in, how it was built, and the executable that came out.

title: Software bill of materials
description: One SBOM of the executable, written from the build record's module inventory.

title: Application image
description: The image and its record: the build it came from, the CA bundle it carries, and its digest.

title: Image signature
description: The keyless cosign signature of the image and of its SBOM attestations.

title: Image publication
description: Where the image was published.

title: Declaration
description: What one service is. An agent writes it, and it is the only artifact STEGO accepts as input for a service.

title: Entity
description: One data shape the service keeps. It states fields and their constraints, and it states no access pattern.

title: Entity field
description: One field of an entity: its name, its type and the constraints the generated code checks.

title: Collection
description: One access pattern over an entity: its scope, the operations it allows and the path it is served at. Several collections may read one entity with different scopes and operations.

title: Slot binding
description: One place where the service's own rules enter the generated code: the collection and slot it binds, the operator that composes the fills, and the fills themselves.

title: Component setting
description: One value the declaration gives a component of its archetype, checked against that component's own schema.

title: Experimental acceptance
description: One statement that this service accepts a component that is not ga, with the date the acceptance runs out. It is the only way an experiment reaches a service, and it expires.

title: Fill module
description: One module the declaration lets the service's fills import, besides their slot contracts and the Go standard library.

title: Digest lifecycle
description: The standing of one published component digest.

title: Supersession
description: A statement that the digest has a successor, with the date after which the digest fails.

title: Withdrawal
description: A statement that the digest must not be used any more, with the date after which it fails.

title: Compiler release
description: One compiler release and its qualification, as qualification.json records it.

title: Required job result
description: The conclusion of one job that qualification requires.

title: Release asset
description: One file of the published release.

title: Compiler installation
description: One installed compiler: the binary and its signed build record in a result folder.

title: Platform requirements
description: The service's platform-requirements.yaml.

title: Platform requirement
description: One thing the environment must supply, such as a secret with its keys or an egress endpoint with its port.

title: Delivery pipeline
description: The generated workflow or PipelineRun file.

title: Kubernetes base
description: The kustomization.yaml and the resources it lists.

title: Delivery object
description: The Argo CD Application for the service.

title: Delivery candidate
description: The image, the build it must match, and who built it.

title: Check result
description: The result of one STEGO check on the candidate.

title: Fill
description: The fill as fill.yaml states it: its name, the slot it implements and the collection it serves. Its code and tests sit beside fill.yaml.

title: Test evidence
description: The record, in fill.yaml, that the fill's tests passed against one exact state of the fill and of its slot contract.

title: Sign-off
description: A person's signature, in fill.yaml, of the fill's test evidence. It vouches that a person lets this exact fill ship.

title: Service build record
description: What one service was built from: the record in .stego/state.yaml. A reader can parse it without STEGO.

title: Component pin
description: One component the service was built from, with its version and its digest.

title: Generated file
description: One file that apply wrote, with the hash of the content it wrote.

title: Recorded input
description: One project file that apply read, as the input manifest records it.

title: Pending apply
description: The journal in .stego/transaction.yaml of an apply in progress. It exists only until the apply or its recovery completes.

title: Saved plan
description: A plan that stego plan saved under .stego/, for apply to carry out exactly. It is local working state, not committed, and apply can also run without one.

title: Registry
description: One active set of parts a service builds from, composed from its sources at one reference each.

title: Namespace
description: The output path a component may write into, which keeps one component's output out of another's.

title: Archetype
description: One curated component set with its conventions.

title: Component binding
description: One component the archetype includes, and the port it answers by default.

title: Mixin
description: An addition to an archetype that brings further components and slots, and replaces nothing.

title: Port
description: One named contract between components. Its providers must all mean the same thing by it.

title: Port field
description: One field every provider of the port fills, with the meaning each provider must keep. This is where two providers can silently disagree.

title: Slot
description: One typed extension point a component declares.

title: Component
description: One deterministic generator with its config schema, the ports it requires and provides, the slots it offers and its maturity stage. It is versioned and released as one unit.

title: Registry source
description: One registry the active set is composed from: the common registry, or a local registry that adds to it.

title: Quality evidence
description: One piece of evidence that a component version meets the ga quality bar: a security review, a benchmark against a reference or a design review, made at the component's exact digest; a reference comparison of its contract set, made at that set's exact digest; or a conformance pass for a port it provides. A benchmark holds its figures per reference as Benchmark figure rows, so versions can be compared.

title: Compared promise
description: One promise a reference implementation makes, as a reference comparison judged it: adopted as a contract of the component, or declined with a reason.

title: Benchmark figure
description: One figure a benchmark measured against one reference: the metric, its value and unit, and which direction is better, so two versions of the component can be compared and a regression reported.
